item.title: One Month In: Why Tokki Korean is the All-in-One App You’ve Been Waiting For
item.description: Discover Tokki Korean, the all-in-one Korean learning app that combines SRS flashcards, dictionary, grammar, EPUB/PDF reader, YouTube subtitles, TOPIK practice, and offline learning in one seamless experience.
